question: What is the meaning of typical average rate of reuse of the product type in relation to reuse?
data_point: typical average rate of reuse of the product type
description: The typical average rate of reuse of the product type in relation to reuse refers to the frequency at which a product is typically reused for its intended purpose. This metric provides information on how often a product can be used again without being damaged when moved to a different location.
